Singapore Banks Stock Analysis

Built an interactive Power BI dashboard

title: About Me
text:
I am an aspiring Data Analyst with a Diploma in AI and Data Science. I am passionate about turning raw data into actionable business insights.



Data Cleaning & Analysis: Python (Pandas, NumPy, yfinance)
Data Visualization: Power BI
Databases: SQL (MySQL)
Other Tools: Git, Jupyter Notebook, Excel, Visual Studio Code, Matlab




I recently completed a stock analysis project on Singapore’s 3 major banks (DBS, OCBC, UOB). I analyzed 5 years of data, answered 4 business questions, and built an interactive dashboard.
🔗 [View Project on GitHub] (https://github.com/Salguod310/singapore-banks-stock-analysis)
